scope: Ordinary native UI input validation; no response injection/delay. Two real Free static create attempts were refused before resource creation. Paid types were inspected without submission.
replay: Use scripts/qa-login.sh with your own session. Fresh-load /services/new?type=static_site; Public Git URL https://github.com/bex-co/bex, own unique Name, branch main, build blank, Auto-deploy off. Leave Publish Directory empty on desktop or enter three spaces on mobile. Record button enabled, click, and select the native CreateService response matching your own name. The request and complete response are in the receipts. Stop if a future server starts accepting blank paths; inventory and clean up any resulting own fixture.

request.query:
mutation CreateService($name: String!, $ownerId: String, $environmentId: String, $type: String, $repo: String, $image: String, $registryCredentialId: String, $branch: String, $rootDir: String, $runtime: String, $buildCommand: String, $startCommand: String, $dockerfilePath: String, $buildFilter: BuildFilterInput, $plan: String, $autoDeploy: Boolean, $schedule: String, $command: String, $publishPath: String, $port: Int, $envVars: [EnvVarInput], $secretFiles: [SecretFileInput]) {
  createService(
    name: $name
    ownerId: $ownerId
    environmentId: $environmentId
    type: $type
    repo: $repo
    image: $image
    registryCredentialId: $registryCredentialId
    branch: $branch
    rootDir: $rootDir
    runtime: $runtime
    buildCommand: $buildCommand
    startCommand: $startCommand
    dockerfilePath: $dockerfilePath
    buildFilter: $buildFilter
    plan: $plan
    autoDeploy: $autoDeploy
    schedule: $schedule
    command: $command
    publishPath: $publishPath
    port: $port
    envVars: $envVars
    secretFiles: $secretFiles
  ) {
    id
    name
    type
    phase
    projectId
    environmentId
    registryCredentialId
    latestDeployId
    __typename
  }
}
